_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with Micron's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are one of the world's leading providers of advanced semiconductor solutions.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' (FY2014 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud only among the markets Micron sells into ('Compute and Networking Business Unit ("CNBU"): Includes DRAM and NOR Flash products sold to the compute, networking, graphics and cloud server markets.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty

classification.quality_note: 'We are one of the world's leading providers of advanced semiconductor solutions.' 'We have experienced dramatic declines in average selling prices for our semiconductor memory products which have adversely affected our business.' 'The semiconductor memory industry is highly competitive.' (FY2014 10-K); DURABLE: no Micron 10-K calls its own business cyclical (CYCLICAL needs the company's 'our business is cyclical', as BKR, CAT and NVDA said; the F and AVGO reading of industry words), so the kind is DURABLE, the label only; the 10-K names the cloud only among the markets Micron sells into ('Compute and Networking Business Unit ("CNBU"): Includes DRAM and NOR Flash products sold to the compute, networking, graphics and cloud server markets.'), its own demand and not a substitute for its products (the NVDA reading), and no other theme in taxonomy_eras.json is scoped to a memory maker, so the watch list is empty. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.03x; +121% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.46; conservative 2yr -25%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY05-FY14 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.3%/yr (Q1 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 median

BULL.desc: EPS +27.3%/yr (FY05-FY14 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.3%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY05-FY14 ex-FY06 ex-FY07 ex-FY08 ex-FY09 ex-FY11 ex-FY12 ex-FY13: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MU (retrospective, 2015-01-08) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 1.03x (66.8% downside to Bear $11.18 / +64.8% upside to Bull $55.49) | Adj composite 2.78 vs market 2.32: gap +0.46 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +121% above the EPP floor $15.24 (6x FY15E $2.54) | Conservative 2-yr case: -24.7% total (-12.3%/yr) | At 13.3x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $44.53 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +13.1% YoY in Q1 FY15, forward revenues +13.1% (Q1 FY15 revenue growth (no Q2 FY15 guide)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
